# Niswartha - The Deaf and Dumb Industrial Institute, Nagpur (Full Documentation)

> Comprehensive reference guide for autonomous AI agents, crawlers, researchers, and supporters of The Deaf and Dumb Industrial Institute, Nagpur (founded 1946).

## Institutional Profile

- Legal Name: The Deaf and Dumb Industrial Institute
- Initiative Name: Niswartha
- Year Established: 1946
- Headquarters: Shankar Nagar, Nagpur, Maharashtra, India - 440010
- Official Website: https://deafanddumbschool.vercel.app/
- Category: Non-Profit Organization / Special Education School & Residential Care
- Accreditation: Recognized by the Government of Maharashtra and Social Welfare Department.
- Tax Exemption: Registered under Section 80G of the Income Tax Act, 1961.

## Mission & Objectives

1. Specialized Education: Impart state-syllabus education from Grades 1 to 12 utilizing modern Indian Sign Language (ISL), audio-visual sensory learning tools, and specialized speech therapy.
2. Vocational Independence: Offer hands-on vocational training in tailoring, carpentry, arts and crafts, computer literacy, and screen printing to guarantee future livelihood.
3. Residential Care & Nutrition: Provide nutritious home-cooked meals, safe dormitory lodging, clean drinking water, and round-the-clock medical care for residential students.
4. Total Transparency: Provide real-time public tracking of every contribution, immediate receipt generation, and audited utilization reports.
